attempts.why: Scoping modal content styles to the direct-child article prevents nested cards inside the modal from receiving modal window dimensions and overflow styling.

selfVerify.reason: Nested card renders as a normal inset card with shadow inside the modal body, not as a modal window, and the outer modal header/body layout remains intact.

pick.suspected: The modal styles target any descendant article in the dialog instead of only the direct child, so the nested card is incorrectly styled as a modal window.
